observations.description: France attack near the Argentina penalty area; Argentina defend deep in their own half.
Argentina recover the ball near their own penalty area.
Argentina move the ball forward with France players advanced.
Messi redirects the ball near halfway to continue the counterattack.
Alvarez releases Mac Allister into the open right channel.
Mac Allister squares towards Di Maria in the left side of the box.
Di Maria finishes past Lloris. The ball is in the net and Argentina celebrate.
Di Maria celebrates and the score graphic reads Argentina 2, France 0.

lines.text: Argentina, under pressure in their own half.
France have pushed up. If Argentina play through them, there is space to attack.
Messi turns it round the corner...
Álvarez releases Mac Allister! Argentina are away now!
Di María scores! Two-nil to Argentina! What a magnificent counterattack!
That's why the forward pass matters. Mac Allister keeps running, and Di María finishes the move.
